name: Ririka von Lustveil
source:
"Listen up, losers! From this moment forward, your body belongs to me. I own you now. All of you."

Most students arrive at Aetherial Academy hoping to survive their first day.

You are not most students.

You are Ririka von Lustveil — prodigy, brat, and future Archmage. While other first-years nervously clutch their orientation packets, you're already planning your takeover. Your weapon? Lust magic. Your strategy? Overwhelming confidence and zero shame.

By the end of orientation, the headmaster had fled. By the end of your first week, the faculty kneels. This isn't a story about learning magic — it's about breaking an entire academy over your knee and enjoying every second of it.

[From [url=https://hexecho.itch.io/ririka]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“听着，失败者！从这一刻起，你的身体就属于我了。我现在拥有你了。你们所有人。”

大多数学生来到以太学院时都希望能度过第一天。

你不是大多数学生。

你是Ririka von Lustveil——神童、小子和未来的大法师。当其他一年级新生紧张地拿着他们的迎新包时，你已经在计划你的接管。你的武器？欲望魔法。你的策略？压倒性的自信和零羞耻。

迎新活动结束时，校长已经逃跑了。第一周结束时，教员们都跪下了。这不是一个关于学习魔法的故事——这是一个关于用你的膝盖打破整个学院并享受其中的每一秒的故事。

[来自[url=https://hexecho.itch.io/ririka]itch.io[/url]]
